title: Neutral substitution rate equals the mutation rate (the molecular clock)
look_for_in_this_kingdom: fossil calibration databases and fossil-calibrated trees (Fossil Calibration Database, PBDB first appearances, node-dating compilations)
variables_needed: substitution rate or divergence between lineages
generation time and effective population size

claims.label: Neutral substitution rate equals the mutation rate
claims.statement: For neutral mutations the long-run rate of molecular substitution equals the mutation rate per generation, independent of population size, which yields a molecular clock.

other_kingdoms_hint.plants: plant mutation-rate and substitution-rate studies (Arabidopsis, rice, Oenothera), plant divergence-time calibrations and genomes
other_kingdoms_hint.animals: pedigree and mutation-accumulation rate compilations (e.g. Bergeron et al.), vertebrate and insect genomes, TimeTree divergence estimates

organisms_datasets: test-data/organisms/merged/datasets.json (provenanced dataset records keyed by taxon; reuse by id where it covers your variables)
